label: the shipped graphics profiles, steady state, the vista by day
comment: The variants below are the profiles in project/graphics_profiles.gd,
key for key. They are not a proposal: changing a number here without
changing it there makes the report describe a client nobody runs.
The vista is the scene from graphics.json, because the tiers differ
mostly on how much world is drawn (view_range, lod_distance,
far_distance) and that can only be seen from somewhere with distance
in it. What this scene cannot measure is shadow_lamps, free at noon
with nothing lit: profiles-night.json is the other half.
Steady state only, which makes this a live sweep: one process, one
block set, one light pool, the profile the only thing that moves.
That is deliberate and it replaces an earlier version of this plan
that ran all four tests with a process each.
Why that version was abandoned, measured 2026-08-30: with a shared
warm store the store keeps filling as the plan runs, so each variant
starts from a fuller world than the one before it. The end-of-plan
control repeat came out 45.7 per cent from the first control on the
steady median and 84.6 per cent on the moving one, and the tiers
settled in 135, 19, 28 and 107 seconds in the order they were run.
Nearly every result was under that noise. Give each variant a cold
store instead and nothing converges at all: this vista took 400,000
blocks over twenty minutes on a cold store and never settled. Load
and streaming numbers therefore want a plan that hands every run an
identical pre-warmed store, which this harness cannot yet do, and
they are not attempted here rather than being reported wrong.
GOANNA_STORE still points at a warm store, but now only one process
reads it, so there is nothing for it to bias.
Read the far_distance rows against the grant the server actually gave:
the client takes the lesser of the grant and the setting. The reference
server was raised to goanna_far_rendering_distance = 2048 for these, so
all three tiers differ on it. At the 512 it shipped with, ultra and high
both came out at 512 and the top of the ladder was flat for that reason
alone.
screen_space_detail, shadow_detail and light_ssil are in every variant
because they are in every profile. They were added on 2026-08-30 after
the older quality sliders were measured and found to scale an effect's
output while its pass ran regardless; these are the ones that actually
cost, and between them they are worth more than the geometry is.
